Page ground pure white #ffffff, text near-black #15191E, muted text #4F5966, hairline rules #D5DBE2. Typography: Archivo in heavy weight for all headings, sentence case and tight leading, like eye-chart letters. Public Sans regular for running text. HEADER on white: the wordmark in Archivo bold at the left, plain text navigation in the middle, and one navy #15233A rectangular button with slightly squared corners and light #EEF2F6 text at the far right (the only button on the screen). DUOCHROME BAND: a full-width section split exactly down the middle into two flat colour fields, left half red #E04848 and right half green #3FA36B, like the red-green duochrome test used in eye exams. Each half holds one large heavy Archivo heading in near-black #15191E and one short sentence beneath, left-aligned with ample padding. This band is the most striking element of the page. SERVICES on white, partly visible below the band: a chart-like list on the left eight columns where service names descend in size row by row, each separated by a hairline rule, with a small muted note beside each name. On the right four columns, a single fine ink line drawing of an optometrist's trial frame (adjustable metal test spectacles with round lens slots) in thin #15191E lines on plain white, isolated, with no text, hands or faces. Below that, the start of a narrow full-width deep navy #15233A strip with one line of light #EEF2F6 text. Flat colours only: no gradients, no shadows, no glass effects, no icons, no emoji, no pill shapes, no centred layout. Crisp, confident, precise, specific to an eye-care shop."}
